title: Used Fable to create my own GTA online where players create their own content
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
Can't belive one guy created a car that looks like a dog :D

it works like this: prompt your own car, prompt your own weapon, prompt your own buildings and try to conquer whole planets (= servers).

Using claude code with fable and codex for development.

What do you guys think? Would you play something like this?

You can try it here: [https://flair-3d.fly.dev/](https://flair-3d.fly.dev/)
